segments.name: Canada
segments.description: Gold mining and milling in Ontario, including the Froome mine and Stock mill in the Fox Complex.
segments.evidence: During 2025, production consisted of 100% doré from the Gold Bar Mine Complex, 98% doré and 2% slag and fine carbon from the Fox Complex, and 91% doré and 9% slag and fine carbon from El Gallo.

segments.name: United States
segments.description: Gold mining via heap leaching at the Gold Bar Mine Complex in Nevada.
segments.evidence: Current production is from our Pick, Ridge and Gold Bar South deposits.

segments.name: Mexico
segments.description: Gold and silver operations at El Gallo in Sinaloa, including planned heap leach material reprocessing.
segments.evidence: At El Gallo in Sinaloa, Mexico, mining and crushing activities ceased during the second quarter of 2018.

segments.name: MSC
segments.evidence: Minera Santa Cruz S.A. ("MSC"), the owner of the San José mine, is responsible for and has supplied to us all reported results from the San José mine.

segments.name: McEwen Copper
segments.evidence: a 46.3% interest in McEwen Copper Inc., the owner of the Los Azules copper project ("Los Azules") in San Juan, Argentina

revenueModel.text: Customers buy gold and silver in end products, generally sold at the prevailing spot market price per ounce at the time of sale.
revenueModel.evidence: Gold and silver contained in our end products are generally sold at the prevailing spot market price per ounce at the time of sale.

changes.text: In August 2024, the United States segment was expanded through the acquisition of Timberline Resources Corporation, forming the Gold Bar Mine Complex.
changes.evidence: In August 2024, we expanded our portfolio of exploration-stage properties in Nevada through the acquisition of Timberline Resources Corporation ("Timberline").
